# NEW UPDATE: CLONKBALL ⚽🔫
**Shoot the ball. Bend the shot. Score the goal.**

ClonkBall is chaotic team gameplay where your weapons control the ball—angle your shots, add spin, and pull off ridiculous plays. Earn currency each round and grab new weapons mid-match to turn things in your favor. Fast, competitive, and a little bit unhinged.

[media]

**Move Different. Play Different.**
Swing your arms to run. Triple jump through the air. Climb anything made of yellow clay. Fire oversized weapons and cause absolute chaos.

[media]

**More Ways to Clonk**
🏁 Race modes with high-speed parkour
💥 Arena fights where anything goes
🌀 Social hubs to hang out, explore, and mess around with friends

Join the Community
Jump into the Discord for events, updates, and everything else.

**Prepare to get Clonked.**
